meta.name: xbox_only_tony_goopsta_rollup
meta.intent: Xbox / Nitrado mission patcher rollup. No PC mods, no init.c dependencies.
sources: patchercomp.zip (Tony/Goopsta Jan 4 2026 fixes + live_xbox patch prototypes)

patches.name: xbox_lockedcontainers_copy_json
patches.description: Copy LockedContainers_Spawns.json into mission custom/ so it can be referenced by object spawner config. (Disabled by default; enable only if you are NOT using CE event spawns for StaticContainerLocked.)

patches.name: xbox_cfggameplay_enable_objectspawner_lockedcontainers
patches.description: Append LockedContainers_Spawns.json to WorldsData.objectSpawnersArr (non-destructive append_unique). (Disabled by default; enable only if you are NOT using CE event spawns for StaticContainerLocked.)

patches.name: xbox_vehicle02admin_events_definition
patches.description: Create/refresh db/events.xml event Vehicle02Admin with safe radius 500 and a Hatchback_02 child.

patches.name: xbox_vehicle02admin_eventpos
patches.description: Create/refresh cfgeventspawns.xml event Vehicle02Admin at (x=10376.90 z=14214.80 a=63.438690). Removes old admin-hatchback event names if present.

patches.name: xbox_container_keys_unrestrict
patches.description: Remove accidental Military/Weapons/Tier4 restrictions on ShippingContainerKeys_* entries in db/types.xml (if present).

patches.name: xbox_locked_container_types_nominal0
patches.description: Upsert Land_ContainerLocked_*_DE type entries with nominal=0 (event/object-spawner controlled).

patches.name: xbox_globals_counts_goopsta
patches.description: Apply Goopsta/Tony globals.xml counts: ZombieMaxCount=1234, AnimalMaxCount=200, LootDamageMin=0.0, LootDamageMax=0.82.

patches.name: xbox_staticcontainerlocked_events_definition
patches.description: Upsert db/events.xml event StaticContainerLocked (vanilla Sakhal locked containers event definition).
